description: This file contains JavaScript functions for managing search and replace functionality within the TinyMCE editor popup, including UI interactions and command execution.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the search/replace popup, sets up UI based on arguments.

methods.name: searchNext
methods.description: Performs the next search or replace operation based on current mode.

methods.name: manageReplaceButtons
methods.description: Shows or hides replace buttons depending on current mode.

methods.name: copyValues
methods.description: Copies input values between search and replace panels.
